shared_elements: incised/pecked linear motifs on a large flat stone surface
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic incised marks including angular zigzag-like clusters and long curving lines, which is about as generic a correspondence as rock-carving can offer. A shows a clearly organised composition of registers with recognisable motifs (arcs, discs/heads, a horizontal band of chevrons, snake-like forms) in ordered rows, whereas B shows a loose, unstructured scatter of pecked strokes with no legible figures or registers.
